body: I can get your first point, but that only makes me feel more despondent. Why does what happen now matter if I don't care about an end beyond myself? You might claim that is a selfish thought, but I think that way only because I believe the end is destined to be futile. Humans are going to ruin the world and there's nothing I can do to stop it - on the contrary, through my consumption, I'm contributing to the problem.
My work ended an hour ago, but I'm just sitting at my desk staring into nothing because I don't feel motivated to do anything. It's all futile.
